gloss: desk work; office duty; indoor work

definitions.gloss: desk work; office duty; indoor work
definitions.explanation: Work performed inside the office, as opposed to fieldwork or outside sales. Also refers to a person assigned to such duties.

examples.english: Today is a desk work day.

examples.japanese: {内勤|ないきん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{外回|そとまわ}り→外回り：17708_sotomawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧になった。
examples.english: I was transferred from office duty to outside sales.

examples.japanese: {内勤|ないきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{運動不足|うんどうぶそく}→運動不足：08567_undoubusoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧がちだ。
examples.english: Since my work is mostly at a desk, I tend to not get enough exercise.

notes:
Used in workplace contexts to distinguish between people who work at their desks in the office and those who go out to meet clients or do fieldwork. Can function as a noun modifier: {内勤|ないきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧ (office-based employees).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内勤|ないきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: desk/office work
- {内勤|ないきん}⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧: office-based employee
- {内勤|ないきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be transferred to office duty

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外勤|がいきん}: outside work, fieldwork — the direct opposite of {内勤|ないきん}
- ⟦{外回|そとまわ}り→外回り：17708_sotomawari⟧: outside rounds, visiting clients — similar to {外勤|がいきん} but more colloquial
- デスクワーク: desk work — loanword, used more casually and not specific to job classification
